title: Regression: External App Extensions fail to start
author: DavidZagury
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Previous Working Version

202411

### Steps to Reproduce

Install external app extensions (e.g - example extenion https://github.com/stepanblyschak/sonic-example-extension)
Enable feature.

This started after the merge of https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-utilities/pull/3791 & https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/pull/21882
This PR changed the docker create function on the sh script from using the hash of the image to using {repo}:latest - latest is not a tag that we can ensure exists.

### Impact of this regression

App extension fails to start.

### Relevant log output

```shell
2025 Mar  5 15:40:01.373999 switch ERR container: docker get image version for cpu-report failed with 404 Client Error for http+docker://localhost/v1.43/containers/cpu-report/json: Not Found ("No such container: cpu-report")
2025 Mar  5 15:40:01.380920 switch ERR container: docker cmd: wait for cpu-report failed with 404 Client Error for http+docker://localhost/v1.43/containers/cpu-report/json: Not Found ("No such container: cpu-report")
```

### Output of `show version`, `show techsupport`

```shell

```

### Attach files (if any)

_No response_

comments.author: liushilongbuaa
gechiang
comments.body:
> [@gechiang](https://github.com/gechiang) , according to the log, it is related with utilities' PR. I think add a special case for cpu-report docker in j2 template file is better. Revert utilities' PR will cause dhcp_relay and macsec docker have wrong name.

Tag @DavidZagury , @vivekrnv  to consider the alternate fix to address this issue instead of reverting the change.

comments.author: DavidZagury
comments.body:
> How about change [docker_image_ctl:L741](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/blob/f2671cd09c8f942dcf8c426999d3cf8a5df1d3d0/files/build_templates/docker_image_ctl.j2#L741)?
@liushilongbuaa 

Yes, this is probably the correct place to add a condition that will keep the app extension infrastructure working.
If you have a fix that will work and keep your change, please provide a PR.

> Or tag cpu-report with latest tag?

The app extensions infrastructure does not (and should not) force the user to only use app extensions tag as latest.

> [@gechiang](https://github.com/gechiang) , according to the log, it is related with utilities' PR. I think add a special case for cpu-report docker in j2 template file is better. Revert utilities' PR will cause dhcp_relay and macsec docker have wrong name.

The cpu-report is not a special case that need to be hard-coded into the code.
cpu report is just an example to an app extensions, it was created by @stepanblyschak  as part of design of the app extension infrastructure, and it was meant to be use as an example to how app extension should behave.

We need to support all app extension, not to force the example one to work :) 


> > [@gechiang](https://github.com/gechiang) , according to the log, it is related with utilities' PR. I think add a special case for cpu-report docker in j2 template file is better. Revert utilities' PR will cause dhcp_relay and macsec docker have wrong name.
> 
> Tag [@DavidZagury](https://github.com/DavidZagury) , [@vivekrnv](https://github.com/vivekrnv) to consider the alternate fix to address this issue instead of reverting the change.

@gechiang 
If there is a fix PR I will surly would not push for a revert.
I am requesting a revert only as an immediate fix for a regression that has not been resolved.
If we have a fix - great, let push it. If we don't have one yet (or at least very soon), we need to revert back to keep the infra working, and return this commit once we have a fix.

linkedPullRequests.title: [sonic-package-manager] Use tag to start application
linkedPullRequests.author: DavidZagury
linkedPullRequests.body:
This is done in order to be able to start using tag which will provide a user-friendly identifier when running docker ps.

Needed PR: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-utilities/pull/3917
#### Why I did it
To fix https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/22124 while keeping the wanted ability to get real image while using docker ps

##### Work item tracking
- Microsoft ADO **(number only)**:

#### How I did it
- Modified `docker_image_ctl.j2` to add support for using `docker_image_tag` when starting containers
- Added a new condition to check if `docker_image_tag` is defined and not none
- If a tag is specified, it will be used instead of the default `latest` tag

#### How to verify it

1. Install a package using sonic-package-manager
2. Run docker ps to verify that the container is running with the correct tag
3. Check the container configuration to ensure the tag is properly saved
